description: The two decisions of watching an agent without hooks: which logs are new since the tick last looked, and whether the agent has gone silent. Format and how to add a case: docs/manuals/foreignSessionSpec.md

changed.note: Registration takes the directory as it is: nothing written before it is new
A log written to since the last look is handed to the wrapper, the others are not
Logs that were not there before are new, in the order they were written
A time that moved back still means the file changed
Logs written in the same second come by name, so two runs hand them over in one order
A log that is gone is nothing to hand over

silent.note: The last put follows the newest log: the wrapper keeps up
Logs ahead of the last put by less than fifteen minutes: a slow wrapper, not a broken one
Logs more than fifteen minutes ahead of the last put: the wrapper stopped delivering
No put yet and nothing written since registration: history, not silence
No put since registration while logs keep being written: the wrapper never worked here
A put from before registration does not move the start of the count back
